title: Elsie Hewitt Thanks ‘Baby Daddy’ Pete Davidson for Olivia Dean Concert Tickets: ‘Her Music Has Given Me So Much’
summary: Hewitt took to Instagram to share her sweet connection to Dean's music with her daughter.
contentText:
Elsie Hewitt had an amazing time seeing the soulful pop singer Olivia Dean’s Madison Square Garden show, and she had her “baby daddy” Pete Davidson to thank for it.

The model/actress attended Dean’s The Art of Loving Live concert at New York’s Madison Square Garden on Monday (Aug. 17), sharing a carousel of photos from the night on Instagram with featured audio “Baby Steps” by Dean. In the caption, Hewitt revealed just how meaningful Dean’s music has been to her and her 8-month-old daughter, Scottie Rose, whom she shares with Davidson.

“Scottie crawled for the first time to this song,” Hewitt wrote with a crying emoji. “We dance to Olivia Dean every day. It’s our album. Her music has given me so much and been with us thru every up and down this year.”

She then shared a fun nod to the heartbreak that inspired some of Dean’s music, adding, “I hope whoever fumbled her is shaking in their boots.”

“But hey thanks for some of the inspo behind The Art of Loving and thanks to my baby daddy for the tix!!!” she continued.

Dean’s sophomore album, The Art of Loving , peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 earlier this year, and has remained a sentimental diary of Dean’s experiences with romantic relationships, heartbreak and self-love. The singer has also previously described the project as a reflection on her evolving understanding of love, including lessons from bell hooks’ cultural critique titled All About Love .

Hewitt and Davidson recently reached a joint co-parenting agreement for their daughter. The former couple, who began dating in 2025, welcomed Scottie in December 2025 before splitting in May. In a statement released after their agreement , the pair said Scottie’s well-being remained their top priority.
